promptEs: En Sol mayor, ¿en qué grado resuelve V/ii?
promptEn: In G major, which degree does V/ii resolve to?
explanationEs: En Sol mayor, V/ii es Mi7 y resuelve en Lam (ii). Su tercera es la sensible de Lam y sube un semitono al resolver.
explanationEn: In G major, V/ii is E7 and it resolves to Am (ii). Its third is the leading tone of Am and rises a semitone when it resolves.
